resources.string: Off by default. With approximate foreground location permission, reads at most three cached provider fixes per scan. Only mock markers and age buckets enter reports. Coordinates may exist transiently in Android objects but are never read, stored or exported. No new fix, background tracking or network request. Local synthetic checks work without this option.
OS permission and provider availability still apply. Denied access is reported separately. Manage permission below; turn this option off in settings at any time.
Local synthetic checks remain available. You can enable cached metadata later in settings.
Optional cached mock markers and age buckets; approximate foreground permission only. No coordinates or active fixes.
